Will stay open in light rain but may close for severe storms or lightning. Tickets are non-refundable and valid during operating hours same year only. No discounts for children or groups unless advertised. Security on site. Beer available for age 21+ with ID. Online ticket purchase recommended; smartphone tickets accepted.
